question: Have there ever been times when Cat-sensei shed tears while watching an anime recording session or a completed episode? If so, could you tell us which episodes?
answer:
There are plenty more after this, but the first was Episode 7—the scene where Subaru jumps off the cliff as “STRAIGHT BET” plays.

I think “STRAIGHT BET” was already included during the voice recording as well, but when I saw the finished footage, it really hit me.

Personally, I think that was the very first time Subaru got to show how cool he could be, so I genuinely couldn't watch it without crying.
